name: Block 1a - Metals Edition
purpose: Understand how global overnight price discovery reaches India before the market opens (India close -> Europe/US close -> Asia open -> India open). Scored question (Q1): does overnight world information, read at 09:00 IST, predict India's retail gold and silver rates (IBJA AM) better than 'same as the previous rate'? Exploratory question (Q2): does the Asian-morning move add anything beyond the 09:00 price?

calendar.start: first weekday after a clean dry run; recorded once in START by 'metals.py set-start'; target 2026-11-27 after a dry run on 2026-11-26; allowed 2026-11-26 to 2026-12-01
calendar.end: the night Block 1's ledger reaches 20 ok observations (count only, read-only)

formula: F = P_ref * (M_09:00 / M_ref) * (FX_09:00 / FX_ref); M_ref and FX_ref = close of the last completed hourly bar ending at or before the reference time of P_ref

bands.name: v0-interim
bands.method: 1.2816 x population standard deviation of the last 65 daily moves up to 2026-11-23 (symmetric, normal 80%). IBJA: PM-to-PM moves from the IBJA page history (the only history published). ETF: open / previous close - 1 from NSE daily files whose content date matches the file name.
bands.goldbees_note: GOLDBEES 1.24% is the band frozen on 2026-11-22 for the manual period, kept as approved; the same method on data to 2026-11-23 gives 1.26%. Reproduce all four with derive_bands.py and the saved IBJA page tests/fixtures/ibja_2026-11-24_holiday.html.
bands.model_band: same width as v0-interim, centred on F instead of P_ref

scoring.day_win: abs(F - actual) < abs(P_ref - actual); an exact tie is not a win
scoring.band_hit: actual inside [centre*(1-band), centre*(1+band)], counted for the model band and the v0-interim band
scoring.usable_day: IBJA published today's AM rate; the 09:00 lock exists, was not late, had fresh inputs for that target and was pushed by 09:15; P_ref exists
scoring.verdict_per_metal: primary target only; gold and silver separately
scoring.pass: usable >= 15 AND wins >= ceil(0.70 * usable) AND model_band_hits >= v0_band_hits
scoring.fail: wins <= floor(0.50 * usable) OR model_band_hits < v0_band_hits
scoring.inconclusive: anything else, including usable < 15 at the hard stop
scoring.secondary: ETF targets get the same daily scores, reported, no verdict

snapshots.note: Historical context records. Never forecast targets; never used by the Q1 formula, scores or verdict; never used for Block 1. A missing item never makes a day unusable.
snapshots.A: India close, 17:30 IST Mon-Fri. Sector state from Yahoo (NSE's index file is not out yet).
snapshots.B: Europe/US close, 03:00 IST Tue-Sat. Sector state from NSE's index file for the last session.
snapshots.C: Asia open, 09:00 IST with the lock. Sector state from NSE's index file for the last session.
snapshots.change_pct: vs the instrument's previous daily close (Yahoo chartPreviousClose; NSE file Change(%))
snapshots.file: snapshots/<date taken>-<A|B|C>.csv; first row SNAPSHOT_<X> carries the time it was recorded
snapshots.gift_nifty: no confirmed free source; one row with no value and source 'unavailable' until one is confirmed

q2_exploratory.name: Asia-morning momentum
q2_exploratory.formula: F_q2 = F * (W_09:00 / W_07:00): the world metal's 07:00-09:00 IST move (China/HK/Japan trading) is assumed to repeat once by the IBJA AM fix
q2_exploratory.w_0700: close of the last completed hourly bar ending at or before 07:00 IST
q2_exploratory.signal: abs(W_09:00 / W_07:00 - 1) >= 0.05%; days without a signal are left out
q2_exploratory.day_win: abs(F_q2 - actual) < abs(F - actual), on usable Q1 days with a signal; ties are not wins
q2_exploratory.label: fewer than 15 signal days: 'too few days'; else 'lead found' if wins >= ceil(0.7n), otherwise 'nothing found'. Reported with the chance of that many wins by luck. Never a PASS/FAIL and never part of the Q1 verdict.

storage.ibja: parsed rates + page SHA256; the raw page only when parsing fails or no rate is found
storage.nse: only the GOLDBEES/SILVERBEES rows + the NSE file's SHA256, never a copy of the whole file
storage.snapshots: three small CSVs a day, 5 columns
